records.name: Early permanent transport network audit
records.scope: Factual audit of selected permanent travel unlocks and their quest-chain gates. It records access conditions, fixed quest rewards, consumable or usage conditions where sourced, and existing repository coverage. It does not score utility, estimate travel time, or recommend route order.

already_represented: The Dig Site, 100 Museum Kudos, and Bone Voyage / Fossil Island access
Children of the Sun Varlamore access
clearly_missing_from_factual_records: The Forsaken Tower and the Lovakengj Minecart Network
Enlightened Journey and the Balloon Transport System
Eagles' Peak and the Eagle Transport System
Kharedst's memoirs / Book of the Dead quest-teleport expansion
represented_but_not_repeated_here: Sailing transport and island access are maintained in the Sailing facts.
Diary transport beyond the Ardougne cloak, item-drop teleports, spellbook-wide teleport analysis, and charged teleport jewellery require their own factual records.

hard_gates.partial_quest_gate: Progress Fairytale II - Cure a Queen through Fairy Godfather permission, the Co-ordinator, and Fairy Fixit. Full Fairytale II completion is not required to use the network.
hard_gates.equipment_condition: A Dramen staff or Lunar staff must be wielded to use a ring unless an in-game exemption has been unlocked; the elite Lumbridge & Draynor Diary removes the staff requirement.

networks.permanent_transport_output: Usable fairy-ring network after the partial Fairytale II permission state, subject to the stated staff or exemption condition.
networks.audit_note: The current repository correctly separates the partial-unlock condition from Fairytale II completion rewards.

hard_gates.network_condition: The Grand Tree spirit tree is additionally usable after both Tree Gnome Village and The Grand Tree are complete.

networks.permanent_transport_output: Access to spirit-tree transport as the Tree Gnome Village quest reward.
networks.audit_note: Player-grown spirit trees, their Farming requirements, and POH spirit-tree construction are separate transport extensions and are not fixed rewards of Tree Gnome Village.

networks.permanent_transport_output: Access to the Gnome glider transportation system.
networks.audit_note: Monkey Madness I activates military gliders; it is an extension of the network rather than a prerequisite for the base post-quest glider system.

The Dig Site.skill_checks: All three listed quest checks are boostable.

hard_gates.Bone Voyage: The Dig Site complete and 100 Museum Kudos; no skill or combat requirement is listed for the quest itself.

permanent_transport_output: Digsite barge quick-travel to Fossil Island
Fossil Island magic-mushtree network after each mushtree is individually discovered
networks.conditional_transport_extension: After Bone Voyage, using a Digsite pendant on the House on the Hill Strange Machine unlocks that pendant's Fossil Island destination. Digsite pendants are charged consumables and are therefore not treated as a permanent, no-input teleport.
networks.audit_note: The existing model already captures the quest chain and distinguishes post-quest optional bank-chest construction from the access gate.

hard_gates.skill_check_note: The listed Agility and Cooking checks are boostable and are not required to start Ghosts Ahoy.
hard_gates.required_combat: Defeat or otherwise handle a level 32 giant lobster during the quest.
hard_gates.variable_or_account_specific_items: The required dye colours are random; the quest also requires Ecto-token acquisition or its documented alternatives, coins, and several listed tools and ingredients.

networks.permanent_transport_output: The Ectophial is refillable at the Ectofuntus and provides repeatable direct teleportation to it. A replacement can be obtained from Velorina under the source's stated condition if the item is lost.

hard_gates.easy_diary: Complete every Easy Ardougne Diary task. The task set includes Rune Mysteries completion, 5 Thieving, a silk sale, Fishing Trawler start, Biohazard completion, a rusty sword and 100 coins for Tindel Marchant, and the other listed easy tasks.
hard_gates.medium_to_elite_extension: Higher cloak tiers require completion of all prior Ardougne Diary tiers and the corresponding task requirements; those tiers are not prerequisites for the cloak 1 monastery teleport.

Cloak teleport allowances.Ardougne_farm: 3 per day at cloak 2, 5 per day at cloak 3, unlimited at cloak 4

networks.permanent_transport_output: Unlimited Ardougne Monastery teleport while the cloak is worn or held; later diary tiers add the stated farm-patch teleports.

hard_gates.The Forsaken Tower_formal_requirements: Completion of Client of Kourend, which requires X Marks the Spot. No skill gate is listed on The Forsaken Tower itself.
hard_gates.usage_cost: The source lists 80 coins to use the Lovakengj Minecart Network during the quest; the network is not modeled as a no-input teleport.

networks.permanent_transport_output: Access to the Lovakengj Minecart Network after The Forsaken Tower completion.

hard_gates.post_quest_route_gates: Individual destinations have their own Firemaking requirement and first-use route-unlock condition; those must be modeled per destination rather than inferred from quest completion.

networks.permanent_transport_output: Access to the Balloon Transport System; subsequent balloon trips consume the source-specified log charge.
Access to the Eagle Transport System.

hard_gates.skill_check_note: The Eadgar's Ruse Herblore check is boostable and required to start.

other: Ability to grow and steal goutweed

networks.permanent_transport_output: Ability to cast Trollheim Teleport and redirect a Teleport to House tablet to Trollheim using a scroll of redirection; individual casts still consume runes or a redirected tablet.
Ability to cast Ardougne Teleport on the standard spellbook; casts consume runes.
